Interface DestinationMarkerView

All Superinterfaces:
DestinationData, MapMarkerView
All Known Implementing Classes:

public interface DestinationMarkerView extends MapMarkerView, DestinationData
DestinationMarkerView represents a location in the robot's mapping space with visual interactive behavior and provides access to the underlying data of the location it represents.
